title: NPCNameTag.cs
summary: A name plate that floats above an NPC's head and always faces the camera. The text follows the NPC's name automatically.

notes.text: Runs in Edit mode too, so the text and height update as you edit the NPC without pressing Play.
The NPC this tag names. Found on the parent automatically if left empty.
The text object inside the tag prefab.
Keeps the tag 'height' metres above the NPC's feet. Untick to place it by hand.
Turns the plate toward the camera while playing, so it reads from any angle.

notes.match: if (npc != null && label != null && label.text != npc.npcName) label.text = npc.npcName;
notes.text: Mirrors NPC > NPC Name into the label. It only writes when the text differs, so Edit mode isn't marked dirty every frame.
The billboard rotation only runs in Play mode, so the tag keeps whatever angle you left it at while editing.
Copying the camera's rotation makes a world-space canvas face the viewer without ever looking mirrored.
